The Babadağ Paragliding Experience

Minute-by-minute: what it's really like to fly from Babadağ Mountain (1,960m) over Ölüdeniz, from nervous anticipation to pure euphoria.

The Morning of Your Babadağ Flight

Your alarm goes off at 7am. You're in your Fethiye hotel room, and there's a knot in your stomach. Is it excitement or fear? Probably both. By 8am, our minibus pulls up. The driver smiles reassuringly — he does this 300 days a year. You climb in with 3 other passengers, all in the same state of nervous excitement.

The 40-minute drive to Babadağ Mountain takes you through pine forests, climbing steadily above the Mediterranean. Through the windows, you catch your first aerial view of the Blue Lagoon — a perfect crescent of turquoise. That's where you'll land.

At the 1,960m Summit

The cable car deposits you at the launch zone. The air is cooler, thinner. Below, the entire Ölüdeniz coastline stretches out like a map. Your THK-licensed pilot introduces himself, checks the wind with a small flag, and starts laying out the wing. It takes 5 minutes to prepare.

The safety briefing is simple: "When I say run, take 3-5 fast steps forward. Don't stop. The wing does the rest." You're strapped into a seated harness with a reserve parachute — though in 100,000+ flights per year, it's almost never needed.

Takeoff: The First 10 Seconds

This is the moment everyone asks about. "RUN!" your pilot shouts. You take three steps, the ground drops away, and... silence. No engine roar. No jolt. Just a gentle lift, like an invisible elevator. Within 5 seconds you're 30 meters above the launch point, and the fear evaporates. It's replaced by something indescribable — the pure, childlike joy of flight.

The Flight: 25-45 Minutes of Aerial Magic

Your pilot catches a thermal — a column of rising warm air — and you spiral gently upward. The altimeter reads 2,200m. Below, you can see:

  • 🌊 The Blue Lagoon in impossible shades of turquoise
  • 🦋 Butterfly Valley — a hidden canyon accessible only by sea or air
  • 🏔️ The Lycian Mountain range stretching inland
  • 🚢 Boats dotting the coastline like white confetti
  • 🦅 Eagles and hawks soaring beside you at eye level

If you booked the 4K Media Package, your pilot's GoPro captures every second. You can also request acrobatic maneuvers — spirals and wing-overs that give you G-force thrills over the open sea.

The Landing on Belcekiz Beach

Your pilot guides the wing toward Belcekiz Beach. The approach is gentle — a long, floating descent over the lagoon. He tells you to stand up in the harness and take 2-3 steps on touchdown. Your feet touch sand. It's over. The biggest grin of your life is on your face.

If you have the media package, your video and 100+ photos transfer to your phone via Wi-Fi within minutes. Most people immediately post to Instagram, sitting on the beach where they just landed, still buzzing.
